note: Release-readiness register (T42, session 2b07e526). One row per named requirement on Amazon's published Application Review Process page (S23), plus the blockers that page creates for this repository. Every 'requirement' cell quotes S23; every measured 'site_state' is a count or a path this repository can be checked against; every row carries the official URL it was read from. A row whose site_state cannot be measured is written OPEN or UNVERIFIED and flagged, never guessed. tools/build_readiness.py renders release/index.html from this file and refuses to publish if a row lacks an official source, if a BLOCKED row lacks a matching open question, or if a stated count disagrees with the tree. Rows that are GAP, BLOCKED, OPEN or UNVERIFIED are surfaced on release/index.html under 'Open items', with the official source of the requirement and an owner action. They are not given F-## ids: the canonical flag register (ledger/flags.json) is owned by another namespace and is not edited here, and F-43..F-46 are not in it.
primary_source_quotes: After you sign up, our Associates team will check your application once you've driven qualified sales (we require at least three within the first 180 days). Please note that personal orders do not qualify.
All Sites must have robust original content (even when advertising is removed) - a good rule of thumb is at least 10 posts.
They must be publicly available (for example, they should not be a closed group, or behind a paywall).
Content on your website must be recent (generally within the last 60 days). You must own your website.
Associates special links are the identifiers (e.g. abcd-20) embedded in Amazon product links. These tags must be embedded in your Amazon product links on the site(s) declared in your application.
Unsuitable Sites cannot participate under any circumstance.
When reviewing a website we look for a beneficial reason as to why a customer would seek out your site.
Please also remember to keep your Site list updated so that we are reviewing the right traffic sources.
Your application must clearly list your social media page's exact URL
